transcript.content: I feel I dyed my red hair the wrong color, which makes me believe I am stupid and incompetent; these feelings and negative thoughts are triggered every time I look in the mirror or hear comments about my hair color.

[System B PsychAgent] Thank you for sharing your current situation (I feel I dyed my red hair wrong, which makes me believe I am stupid and incompetent; every time I look in the mirror or hear others about my hair color). In PDT counseling, we will use cognitive and behavioral frameworks to explore the core distress.
